title: Vegan Irish Couscous Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful vegan Irish couscous bowl made with sautéed vegetables and seasoned with herbs.
instructions: Heat the vegan Irish butter substitute in a large bowl over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for 10 minutes or until tender.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vegan broth and bring to a boil.
Stir in the couscous and cook according to package instructions.
Fluff the couscous with a fork and stir in the chopped parsley and lemon juice.
